text_description: A full runway look cropped from head to below the hips shows a coordinated patterned jacket and skirt worn over a long brown top. The jacket is collarless, open-front, boxy and slightly cropped to the high hip, with structured shoulders and long sleeves; it is covered in a dense grey, white, black and orange abstract woven-looking pattern and finished with highly textured orange-red frayed trim running around the round neckline, down both front edges, around the hem, at the cuffs, and on visible patch-pocket edges. Under it, a warm brown sleeveless-looking long top or tunic sits close to the body and extends past the jacket over the skirt, with a cream/white outlined hem band and a large white interlocking-letter-style motif centered on the chest. The bottom is a matching slim pencil-style skirt in the same grey/orange/black pattern, creating a skirt-suit effect with the tunic layered visibly over it. Styling includes oversized dark sunglasses with a pale frame, large gold-toned earrings, a chunky red-orange beaded necklace, and a small structured burgundy handbag carried low at one side on dark olive straps with gold hardware. The overall mood is polished, graphic and retro-luxe, combining a textured tailored suit silhouette with bold warm trim and statement accessories.
